---
title: "About"
---

JuliaBayes is a shared home for Bayesian software in Julia.
Our goal is to make it easier to collaborate, share maintenance, and keep packages supported over time.

We strive to be an open and welcoming community whose members share an interest in Bayesian statistics, no matter whether that interest is theoretical, applied, or from a software engineering perspective.

We’re open to collaborations across different probabilistic programming languages, research groups, and institutions. 
Most of us contribute alongside our day jobs, so contributions of all sizes are welcome.

Do you want to bring your package into JuliaBayes, or just want to hang out and discuss with us? 
Join us in #bayes on Julia Slack to chat!
